findings.issue: Dispatch decided (closes original) but the test-seam mechanism is not implementable: sleeper/jitter/clock, http:// Endpoint, r-2b wire-builder fault hook, r-2 RunResponse test constructor, r-1 MockJudgeBackend are all '#[cfg(test)]' while the acceptance tests are integration targets (--test retry/ureq/wire/run_response), where the library is built WITHOUT cfg(test).
findings.recommendation: Pick one seam mechanism and state it in r-1/r-2/r-2b/r-3: preferred a non-default additive `test-util` feature per crate (sleeper/clock/jitter injection on BusyPolicy, http-allowed Endpoint ctor, RunResponse test ctor, wire-builder fault hook, MockJudgeBackend), enabled by dev-dependencies, with a release-build test asserting it is off; alternative: keep those tests in-crate and change validation lines to --lib. BusyPolicy needs deterministic jitter + monotonic clock injectable through the same seam.

findings.issue: Partly closed: serde(try_from) fixes validate-on-deserialize, but SubjectsDocument vs ValidatedSubjects (one type or two?) unstated; SubjectsDocument absent from the privacy triage table (pub fields keep the hole); EqualInputRecord stores derived `equal` as a field.
findings.recommendation: SubjectsDocument is THE validated type with private fields, raw-form deserialization, construction via SubjectsBuilder::build or try_from; drop or alias ValidatedSubjects; add to triage table; compute equal in Serialize/accessor or reject mismatch on deserialize.

observations: (a) QuestionAnswer: choice type unstated; probabilities BTreeMap<String,f64> over a closed choice set (f64 blocks Eq, admits NaN); sits beside untouched ChoiceAnswer (two near-duplicate answer types); JudgeOutcome::new does not check keys match request QuestionIds; Deserialize/validation unstated. Suggest ChoiceId newtype, finite-probability rule, stated relationship to ChoiceAnswer.

(b) features seam: type homes across modules unstated (Rev, RepoRoot, RepoRelativePath, BlobSha, Sha256Digest, Operation); `git` must build with error+ids+schema only; sc-agent-http needs CancelToken which sits under `judge` — make cancel always-on or its own feature; add `cargo hack check -p sc-agent-types --feature-powerset` to r-1 validation + CI; state secret/judge independence.

(c) BusyPolicy: 4 sends = 3 waits (1,2,4 s) so '1,2,4,8 capped 30' is never reached by default — say so; HttpRequest/HttpResponse constructed by implementors need ctors/accessors not pub fields; SecretHeader.name newtype.

(d) BackendFailure stores both ScAgentErrorResponse and JevError (can diverge) — store JevError, derive response at serialize; RunResponse non_exhaustive + private fields redundant; ErrorCode as non_exhaustive enum with as_str(); session version newer-than-supported -> SessionDocumentInvalid; backend id has two alias sources (serde alias vs descriptor aliases()) — Deserialize via FromStr.
(e) git helper and clap designs sound; (BlobSha, Vec<u8>) tuple -> small struct.
